Accelerating Innovation: The BioMed X Boot Camp Experience

  1. Home
  2. Career
  3. Boot Camp

What is the BioMed X Boot Camp?

The BioMed X Boot Camp is an immersive, high-intensity innovation week designed for scientists eager to tackle real-world biomedical challenges. Over the course of five transformative days, 15 top candidates—comprising 5 aspiring group leaders and 10 postdocs or research assistants— collaborate to develop groundbreaking project proposals under the mentorship of industry-leading pharmaceutical experts.

Each boot camp is sponsored by a leading pharmaceutical company, which defines the boot camps scientific focus and provides coaching to participants.

At the end of the boot camp, one outstanding group leader will be selected to establish and lead a new fully funded research group at one of BioMed X’s innovation hubs—Heidelberg, New Haven, Ridgefield, Israel, and Barbados. This position includes a 3 to 5 year employment contract, enabling the selected scientist to develop their research into a potentially life-changing innovation in a cutting-edge environment at the intersection of academia and industry.

If you aspire to bridge the gap between academia and industry, push the boundaries of biomedical research, and gain invaluable experience in innovation, the BioMed X Boot Camp is your opportunity to shine.

Why join?

  • Work with pharma experts
  • Real-world challenges and cutting-edge research
  • High-impact networking
  • Hands-on team collaboration
  • Develop and pitch a winning project

The Boot Camp Experience: How it works

Day 1

Team-Building

  • Get to know fellow candidates, their expertise, strengths, and passions
  • Share your preferences for potential teammates to help shape the team formation process

Day 2

Hypothesis-Finding

  • Work in one of five interdisciplinary teams, each centered around a group leader candidate
  • Develop a central hypothesis, supported by scientific rationale and expert mentorship

Day 3

Slide-Making

  • Take a break from science and explore the local area together
  • Design a unique experimental approach based on the central hypothesis with guidance from our scientific mentors

Day 4

Fine-Tuning

  • Strengthen your proposal through practice presentations and constructive feedback
  • Fine-tune your scientific concept, experimental approach, and final pitch with support from experienced mentors

Day 5

Life-Changing

  • Present your team’s research proposal to a jury of scientific experts in a 15-minute presentation, followed by a 15-minute Q&A session
  • Gain valuable insights from the jury and conclude an intensive week of scientific exchange, collaboration, and innovation

What It’s Like to Be Part of the Boot Camp

A Journey of Discovery: Inside the Boot Camp Experience

I definitely walk away a better and more curious scientist.

Thania Rivera, Molecular and Cellular Scientist

Boot camp was like a real booster for the scientific mind – exhausting but energizing. It gave me new friends, fresh ideas, and a unique team start. A mix of scientific approaches and a touch of military training.

Savochkina Elizaveta, Research Assistant

An unforgettable boot camp where bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and real-world insights came together, leaving us inspired and closely bonded after 5 days.

Eunji Hong, Graduate Research Assistant

This year’s bootcamp was an incredible experience! It gave me the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant scientists, deliver tangible outcomes under tight time constraints, and present them with clarity and confidence. These are invaluable skills I look forward to carrying into the next stages of my scientific career.

Mirella Ejiugwoa, Postdoctoral Researcher

I’ve had the privilege of joining two BioMed X boot camps in Heidelberg, where the focus was purely on biological questions for pharma, and later one at AION Labs centered on computational approaches. From my very first experience, I was in love with the BioMed X method: the pressure, the intensity, the brilliant scientists and mentors constantly challenging every idea. It’s only in that environment—under stress but surrounded by people who push you further—that you can achieve something truly meaningful. After just one week, you not only create something completely new, but also build strong connections with people who continue to inspire and support you long after the boot camp ends.

Fedor Lipskerov, PhD Student in Molecular Biology and Science Communicator

Over the course of 70+ intensive hours, I collaborated with brilliant engineers, scientists and doctors to design a new novel platform for intraocular drug screening and an innovative delivery system aimed at improving the quality of life for patients living with retinal diseases. I’m proud of what we accomplished together—and even more excited for the next steps ahead.

Rajin Karpen, Senior Engineer

ABOUT BioMed X

BioMed X is a leading innovation engine where disruptive ideas in biomedical research and development come to life. With our global network of research institutes and venture-creating incubators, embedded within major innovation hubs, we bridge the gap between academic research and the needs of the pharmaceutical industry.

We are pioneers in applying the principles of design thinking and crowdsourcing to drug discovery and development. With our unique model, we partner with pharma, venture capital, and patient-focused foundations to identify key challenges across all therapeutic areas, recruit top talent, and co-create tailored solutions.

In our stimulating ecosystem, talented researchers from all around the globe grow into industry-ready scientific leaders. They perform exploratory research, deliver industry-grade results, and pave the way for next-generation therapies. At BioMed X, we value curiosity, diversity, and purpose. Together, we serve as a vital catalyst for innovation in global health – for the benefit of all patients.
